prompt: Tell a quote from Bhagavad Gita.
response:
Certainly! The Bhagavad Gita is a profound text that offers many inspiring quotes. Here is one of the most well-known and often cited:

"धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय जय एतदभ्युदयम्।
यदा धर्महीनं जगत्त्रावस्तावमीह रणम्॥"

In English, this translates to:

"For the establishment of dharma, O Bharata, I have come down to this world. When dharma declines and adharma (unrighteousness) prevails, then I manifest myself on earth."

This quote emphasizes the importance of righteousness and the role of the divine in maintaining it.
